disposition_reason: Regulation 31(5) prohibits cocoa or cocoa products containing cadmium above 0.5 ppm; the Tenth Schedule sets cocoa powder (calculated on dry, fat-free substance) at arsenic 1 ppm and lead 2 ppm, with chocolate and other cocoa forms falling under 'Other food not specified above' (As 1, Pb 2 ppm); mercury in 'any other food' 0.05 ppm and tin in any food 250 ppm also apply.
disposition_locator: Regulation 31(1), (3)(c), (4), (5) (printed pp. 52-53); Tenth Schedule (b)(6) and (b)(27) (printed pp. 212-213); Regulations 163-170 cocoa/chocolate standards

study.material_scope: cocoa, cocoa products, cocoa powder, chocolate
study.basis: ppm (mg/kg); cocoa powder As/Pb on dry, fat-free substance; others as sold
